meta.title: Two unnamed surrogate bids land on two different vendors
gaps: The read_round response does not expose the individual vendor UUIDs for the two surrogate bids, so we cannot directly confirm they belong to different companies beyond the bid_count check.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live round with the audience to add uuids set to “…”, with the update remarks set to “Invite second vendor for test”.
The buyer enters a surrogate bid of 100 on the vendor's behalf for the invited QA vendor.
The buyer enters a surrogate bid of 101 on the vendor's behalf for a second QA vendor.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that Data check: “bid count” equals 2.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “bid count” equals 2.
